stories.title: Maharashtra to upgrade 3,832 anganwadis with smart classrooms, modern kitchens
stories.summary: Maharashtra will upgrade 3,832 anganwadi centres across the state under a government initiative to improve infrastructure and provide children with better learning facilities, Women and Child Development Minister Aditi Tatkare said on Sunday. stories.summary: Maharashtra has scaled down its tree-plantation drive this year due to acute water shortages caused by severe drought conditions across several districts, Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis said on Saturday. stories.title: 258 seats secured: US Democrats win largest House tally since 1992
stories.summary: US Democrats have secured their largest House majority in more than three decades, winning at least 258 seats in the 435-member chamber after a closely contested North Carolina race was called in their favour. stories.title: COP31 talks fail as EU, others reject any climate deal without language on a fossil fuel phase-out
stories.summary: A standoff on a fossil fuel phase-out prevented countries at COP 31, the United Nations climate talks in Antalya, Turkiye, from achieving any consensus agreement on future climate action on Sunday (November 22, 2026), despite the conference running a record 48 hours into overtime. The European Union led objections to COP 31 President Murat Kurum’s consensus cover text that failed to include any explicit language about moving away from fossil fuels.

stories.title: Suspected Ukrainian sea drones hit Russian warship at Benghazi naval base, Libyan officials say
stories.summary: A suspected Ukrainian drone strike hit a Russian warship on Sunday (November 22, 2026) at a naval base in Libya, officials said, the latest attack in the North African nation linked to the Russia-Ukraine war. stories.title: Democrats win largest House majority since 1992 after flipping North Carolina seat
stories.summary: The Democratic Party has won the largest majority in the US House of Representatives since 1992, after Democrat Chuck Hubbard unseated Republican Representative Virginia Foxx in North Carolina. The race was called on Sunday, with Hubbard beating Foxx by 330 votes with 99% counted. It was one of the closest contests of the recent midterm elections, in which Democrats also secured the Senate.

Artistgndphotography/Getty Images : Preferred Source Google Discover You don't always need a DAC and amp to enjoy music through headphones. If your computer or laptop's headphone jack already delivers clean audio at a comfortable volume, then you're probably fine.

stories.title: Can you safely use a 140w charger on an iPhone?
stories.summary: Yalcin Sonat/Shutterstock : Preferred Source Google Discover The simple answer is yes, an iPhone can tolerate a 140-watt charger, but it's not a simple process, and there are safety considerations. A 140-watt charger is an upper limit that your iPhone will never reach because even the latest iPhone 18 Pro hits its cap at 52W.

stories.title: Why your monitor flickers when you turn it on and can it be fixed?
stories.summary: Dragon Images/Shutterstock : Preferred Source Google Discover If you're someone who spends a decent amount of time in front of a computer, perhaps at work or during long gaming sessions, you may have noticed just how finicky certain parts of your computer can be. That's especially true of its peripherals and accessories, with one of the usual suspects being your monitor.

stories.title: Which solar panel type is best for your home?
stories.summary: More efficient solar panels aren't always the better buy. Your roof, budget and plans for backup power have a say too. MP_Foto/Shutterstock : Preferred Source Google Discover At first glance, all the solar panels in your neighborhood may look much the same, but what they're made of can decide how much power they generate.

stories.title: What the tiny key icon means on your Android device
stories.summary: Max Miller for Engadget : Preferred Source Google Discover The Android status bar is designed to give users important information at a glance, but all those icons can blur together. One of the most unusual symbols looks like a leftward-facing key with two teeth opposite its circular handle.

stories.title: Why has the COP31 climate summit failed to reach agreement?
stories.summary: play video Video Duration 27 minutes 25 seconds play-arrow 27:25 Fossil fuels are at the centre of deep division. The United Nations climate change conference in Turkiye has failed to reach an agreement. Countries in the greatest danger, and the European Union, refused to accept the final text – with deep disputes over fossil fuels.

stories.title: What does the Constitution say about proroguing Parliament? | Explained
stories.summary: Parliament adjourned sine die on August 13, at the end of the last sitting of the Monsoon Session. However, they have not been prorogued to date, making it the longest unprorogued period on record. Article 85 of the Constitution provides for summoning and prorogation of the Houses of Parliament.

stories.title: Bisleri water sample fails FSSAI test: What did inspectors find? What action was taken? What we know
stories.summary: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) has approved prosecution against Bisleri International Pvt Ltd after a sample of its packaged drinking water was declared unsafe. The food safety regulator said the sample did not meet the prescribed limits for bromate. It was also found to contain polynuclear aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) during further testing at a referral laboratory.

stories.title: GTA 6 story explained: Who are Jason and Lucia, and what role do they play in the world of Grand Theft Auto
stories.summary: The story of Grand Theft Auto VI centres on two main characters, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos. Set in the fictional state of Leonida, the game follows the pair as they become involved in a criminal conspiracy after a job goes wrong. The latest instalment in the popular Rockstar Games series takes players back to Vice City, a fictional version of Miami.

stories.title: Explained: The Long Goodbyes Of Sporting Superstars
stories.summary: Dhoni’s remarkable playing career was defined by clarity of thought and astute decision-making. Why, then, did it take him a staggering 11 years, 10 months, and 18 days since his Test retirement, to eventually muster the courage to step off the IPL T20 stage?

stories.title: Everyday explained: What is déjà vu?
stories.summary: Déjà vu feels eerie, like memory playing a trick on the conscious mind. Here is the likely explanation for why almost all humans experience this. Everyone has experienced déjà vu at some point in their lives, often more than once.

stories.title: Explained: 'Poverty, prejudice and profit', how Dhaka was repackaged as New Delhi
stories.summary: A narrow lane in Dhaka. Modest homes, roadside tea stalls, a canal and residents going about their daily lives. ”The camera keeps moving. Tin-roofed houses are described as dirty and unhygienic. These were not scenes from Delhi. For months, the cameras reportedly kept returning to the same streets, homes and markets.

stories.title: Why are so many more young Scots claiming disability benefits?
stories.summary: Scotland political correspondent Published 1 minute ago Every month, more than 12,000 applications are made to Social Security Scotland for disability support. The number of Scots receiving these benefits has risen sharply since the Covid pandemic, and is projected to hit one million by the end of the decade.

stories.title: Is Your Wedding Gold Really Pure? CTI Flags Shocking Adulteration Risks, ₹6 Lakh Crore Marriage Market Faces Trust Crisis
stories.summary: With Tulsi Vivah marking the start of the wedding season , nearly 52 lakh marriages are expected nationwide, generating business worth approximately ₹6 lakh crore. Delhi-NCR alone could witness around 5 lakh weddings, contributing nearly ₹1 lakh crore in business. Gold jewellery purchases traditionally account for a significant portion of wedding expenditure.

stories.title: What Makes Mumbais Royal Opera House Special? A Look At Its 110-Year Legacy And Remarkable Comeback
stories.summary: Some places become part of the city’s cultural fabric. And Mumbai recently celebrated 110 years of completion of one such place. Built in 1916, The Royal Opera House, Mumbai, was restored and reopened in October 2016 and celebrated ten years of the same. It, in fact, had taken a hiatus of 25 years.

stories.title: Western Railway motormen, train managers participate in WNC Navy Half Marathon
stories.summary: Train managers and motormen from Western Railway participated in the WNC Navy Half Marathon 2026 in Mumbai on Sunday, November 22, completing the 5 km and 10 km running categories. The railway employees took part in the event despite their demanding operational schedules, which involve ensuring the safe movement of trains throughout the year.

stories.title: Charlie Puth to make India debut with Ellie Goulding at Mumbai music festival in February 2027
stories.summary: American singer Charlie Puth is set to make his India debut alongside British singer Ellie Goulding at the inaugural Johnnie & Co. Festival in Mumbai on February 13, 2027. The one-day event will be held at the Mahalaxmi Racecourse and is expected to attract more than 35,000 attendees.

stories.title: Mumbai This Weekend: From A Bhakti Concert To A Classic Car Rally, 5 Events To Check Out
stories.summary: Looking for plans in Mumbai this weekend? From an immersive musical experience and a vintage car showcase to a stand-up comedy show and a heritage walk, the city has something for everyone. Whether you want to explore Mumbai's history, enjoy live entertainment or catch a sporting event, here are five activities to add to your weekend itinerary.

stories.title: Mumbai Book Festival to begin on November 24 at University of Mumbai’s Kalina campus
stories.summary: The National Book Trust (NBT) and the Maharashtra government have organised the 'Mumbai Book Festival' starting on November 24 to 29 with the aim of improving the reading culture among people of all age groups . The festival venue will be the University of Mumbai's Kalina campus in Santacruz.

stories.title: ‘Home-sick’: Mumbai exhibition explores Himalayan medicinal plants and disappearing habitats
stories.summary: By definition, homesickness refers to the unhappiness one experiences when away from home for an extended period. However, for Garima Gupta, an artist and researcher based in New Delhi, the term takes on a more layered meaning. Through her exhibition Home-sick, currently on view at TARQ, Gupta considers sickness as both a symptom and a witness — a condition through which stories of exhaustion, displacement and care become perceptible.

stories.title: ‘You are as good as your last performance’: Looking back on 50 years of Mumbai theatre group Ank
stories.summary: At Ank’s studio in Mumbai’s Laxmi Industrial Estate, Preeta Mathur Thakur is preparing understudies for Veera Rani Abbakka , the production the theatre group is performing to celebrate its golden anniversary year. An actor calls to say he is stuck in traffic and will be late for rehearsal.

stories.summary: The competition, which has completed 12 editions, will begin with preliminary rounds on November 21 at various centres across Maharashtra. The large participation includes theatre organisations and college teams, offering a platform for budding actors, writers and directors to showcase their talent.

stories.title: World Press Photos Down To Earth Exhibition Makes India Debut In Mumbai
stories.summary: Organised by World Press Photo in partnership with the Consulate General of the Kingdom of the Netherlands and the Mumbai Press Club, the exhibition brings together 21 award-winning photographic projects. Through powerful visual storytelling, it explores the environmental challenges shaping the planet, and also draws attention to communities, ideas and movements working towards a more sustainable future.

stories.title: Rs 4,000 for an Avengers ticket. Mumbai goes big on Doomsday with added shows
stories.summary: The film has also crossed Rs 10 crore in opening-day advance bookings, with about one lakh tickets sold across PVR INOX and Cinepolis within 19 hours of bookings opening. Directed by Anthony and Joe Russo, the film is scheduled to release in India on December 17, a day before its US theatrical debut.

stories.title: Mumbai art scene: Two exhibitions explore playful chaos and the human figure
stories.summary: For Radhika Simoes Kapoor, art does not have to be philosophical. “ Art is fun ,” shares the Art Institute of Chicago alumna. Today, she will open her first show in almost a decade, Collective Chaos, which features works of mixed media that capture spontaneous chaos and, of course, fun.
